entries.7576d9dec40d72ea: This is a reportable segment engaged in the wholesale and retail of LP gas and related equipment, safety management, customer service, the sale of housing-related equipment, and home services. Reinspection and management of LP gas cylinders are handled by consolidated subsidiary LPG Logistics Co., Ltd., and call center operations and others are handled by TOM Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥20,279 million, and the number of employees was 208.
entries.7cc449f2ad9898f1: Under its corporate philosophy “commerce is serving all people,” it places its logistics strategy at the center of its business, increases supply density and cost competitiveness through its own delivery system and the concentration of its customer base in the Kanto area, and aims to be a lifeline concierge that proposes comfortable living through “fire,” “water” and “air.” The policy is to focus on expanding transactions with customers by promoting sales of the “TOELL Lifeline Package,” which packages gas, water, electricity and communications.

entries.ed2cf413c561b407: Of net sales of ¥27,039 million for the fiscal year ended April 2026, the energy business accounted for ¥20,279 million, about 3/4, and the water business was ¥6,759 million. The MD&A cites that in the energy business revenue decreased because of lower selling prices accompanying the decline in LP gas import prices, while sales volume grew as new customers were acquired through a strengthened sales structure and expanded supply facilities, and that in the water business revenue increased through expanded sales of 3 brands and an increase in server rentals.

It calls its sales offices "TASK Centers" and handles safety and delivery through the TASK system, which operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
